name: inline-approve-button
title: Inline approve button
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A primary action that becomes a success check in place after confirm, without leaving the page.

meta.descriptionEs: El botón primario pasa a un check de éxito en el mismo lugar, sin recargar.

examples.title: Aprobar
examples.description: Uno confirma. El otro falla y el reintento cierra.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: Pendiente, éxito, error, token largo y deshabilitado.

meta.usage:
<InlineApproveButton
  labels={{ idle: "Aprobar el catálogo", success: "Catálogo aprobado" }}
  onConfirm={() => save()}
/>

api.name: onConfirm
api.description: The host save. A resolved promise becomes success. A throw becomes error.

api.name: state / onStateChange
api.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. Success ignores further clicks.

api.name: labels / disabled
api.description: Spanish is the default. inlineApproveLabelsEn is the English set.

docs: Clean-room confirm. onConfirm may return a promise. Pending shows a spinner, success keeps the check, and a throw shows the retry label. The icon swap uses scale 0.25 and stops when motion is reduced. The host saves. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button. The item ships no theme. No mockup source, copy, colors, or assets were copied.
